task.name: Execute Workflow
task.objective: Execute given workflow by loading its configuration, following instructions, and producing output

llm.mandate: Read the selected configuration, control instructions, and template completely; load supporting evidence only as needed.
Save to template output file after EVERY "template-output" tag

WORKFLOW-RULES.rule: Steps execute in numerical order unless their conditions, loops, or explicit jumps select another path.
Use execution-modes below; do not ask to re-enable authorized autonomy.
Interactive checkpoints wait; autonomous synthesis continues without routine confirmation.
Host rules and authorization govern both modes. Wait for consequential input or required approval; never invent answers, treat time as consent, or expand scope.

substep.title: Load Configuration and Resolve Variables
substep.action: Set interaction mode using execution-modes below.
substep.phase: Load external config from config_source path
Resolve all {config_source}: references with values from config
Resolve variables from context. State inconsequential defaults; ask and wait for an unknown required value or consequential choice.

substep.title: Load Required Components
substep.mandate: Instructions: Read COMPLETE file from path OR embedded list (REQUIRED)

check.action: Note the path for later loading when needed.

substep.action: If template: false, mark as action-workflow; otherwise mark as template-workflow.
substep.note: Data files (csv, json) → Store paths only, load on-demand when instructions reference them

substep.title: Initialize Output
substep.action: Resolve default_output_file path with all variables and {{date}}
Create output directory if doesn't exist

check.action: Read and preserve its authored content; apply the requested changes in place instead of replacing it with the blank template.

check.if: the output file does not exist
check.action: Initialize it from the template only after the target is resolved within the authorized scope.

step.title: Process Each Instruction Step in Order

substep.title: Handle Step Attributes
substep.action: Evaluate if="condition" first; omit a step whose condition is false.

check.ask: Include this optional step? Wait for the user's choice.

check.action: Include relevant, authorized work; otherwise omit with a brief reason. Ask only for an unresolved consequential choice.

substep.action: If for-each="item", repeat the step for each item; if repeat="n", repeat it n times.

substep.title: Execute Step Content
substep.action: Process markdown or XML instructions using supported-tags below.
Replace {{variables}} with resolved values; handle unknown values as in step 1a.

if.mandate: Save to file (Write first time, Edit subsequent)

check.action: Summarize the saved section and continue, unless required input or approval is missing.

check.ask:
[a] Advanced Elicitation, [c] Continue, [p] Party-Mode, [y] Complete the rest of this document autonomously within the current authorization. WAIT for response. Start the advanced elicitation workflow {project-root}/_arcwright/core/workflows/advanced-elicitation/workflow.xml
Continue to next step
Start the party-mode workflow {project-root}/_arcwright/core/workflows/party-mode/workflow.md
Use autonomous mode (#yolo alias) for the rest of this document within current authorization.

check.if: interactive mode and the current step has no explicit question, continuation menu, or template-output checkpoint
check.ask: Continue to next step? (y/n/edit). Wait for the user's response.

step.title: Completion

check.action: Verify the document was saved to the resolved output path.

step.action: Report completed work, blockers, and unrun checks accurately.

execution-modes.mode: Use for an explicit request to collaborate step by step, an interview/elicitation task, or a stated interactive workflow choice. Wait at questions/checkpoints; avoid duplicate prompts.

Default for a supplied actionable task unless interactive work was selected. Complete the authorized scope, including full-send or full-stop with their distinct delivery boundaries. Continue routine decisions from evidence, state material assumptions, and wait for missing consequential input or approval. Never simulate discussions or user answers.
execution-modes.note: Mode controls interaction, not permission. Preserve it across calls and resumes unless the user changes it; a local menu choice applies only to its stated scope. Honor later requests to pause, collaborate, or approve.

execution.tag: action - Perform action; an if attribute makes it conditional
check if="condition">...</check> - Conditional block; closing tag required

ask - Use the host question tool when available, otherwise chat; wait before dependent work. Autonomous mode omits only routine continuation/navigation already authorized, never real missing-input or approval questions.
invoke-workflow - Execute named workflow with its inputs and this runner

output.tag: critical - Required within its applicable branch

protocols.desc: Reusable workflow protocols that can be invoked via invoke-protocol tag

protocol.name: discover_inputs
protocol.desc: Smart file discovery and loading based on input_file_patterns
protocol.critical: Only execute if workflow.yaml contains input_file_patterns section

step.title: Parse Input File Patterns
step.action: Use the configured strategy. Otherwise default to INDEX_GUIDED, or SELECTIVE_LOAD when sharded_single resolves to the known target. Execute only that strategy.
Reuse available unchanged inputs across steps and resumes. Recheck affected sources after source/scope changes; expand reads only for missing context, unresolved questions, or concrete risk.

substep.title: Check Relevance and Try Sharded Documents First
substep.action: Evaluate a group's optional when condition against the task before discovery. If false, set {pattern_name_content} to empty, note why, and skip to the next group.
Load fallback groups only for gaps in preferred evidence. Resolve uncertain relevance with an index or heading check, without preloading the group.
Discover file paths matching the sharded patterns, including sharded_single when present, without loading their contents.

strategy.name: FULL_LOAD
strategy.desc: Explicit opt-in for the entire matching corpus.
strategy.action: Use glob pattern to find ALL .md files (e.g., "{output_folder}/*architecture*/*.md")
Load every matching file completely, reusing unchanged content already available.
Concatenate content in logical order (index.md first if exists, then alphabetical)

strategy.name: SELECTIVE_LOAD
strategy.desc: Load a target document or sections, such as the requested epic.
strategy.action: Resolve sharded_single variables (e.g., {{epic_num}}) from context and read the target. Ask and wait for an unresolved consequential target choice.
Without sharded_single, select relevant files/sections using INDEX_GUIDED; no template is required.

strategy.name: INDEX_GUIDED
strategy.desc: Select evidence using an index, headings, or focused search.
strategy.action: Read sharded_index or index.md when present; otherwise discover file names/headings or search for the task's unresolved questions.
Load relevant sections plus necessary definitions, constraints, and dependencies. Read a full supporting document when complete context is needed, not merely for a keyword match.
strategy.note: Record source files/sections. Expand for unanswered required questions; do not claim a targeted read covers the corpus.

check.action: Mark pattern as RESOLVED, skip to next pattern

substep.title: Try Whole Document if No Sharded Found

check.if: no sharded matches found OR no sharded pattern exists

check.action: For FULL_LOAD, read all matches completely. Otherwise apply the selected strategy to relevant files/sections, reusing unchanged content.
Record source paths/sections and unresolved evidence gaps.
Mark pattern as RESOLVED, skip to next pattern

check.if: no sharded or whole matches found
check.action: Note in session: "No {pattern_name} files found". Continue if that input is optional; ask for missing required evidence and keep dependent work pending.

step.title: Report Discovery Results
step.action: Briefly report content variables, strategies, source paths/sections, reused inputs, and missing required evidence, without repeating loaded content.

llm.critical-rules: • Execute {installed_path}/workflow.yaml using this runner: {project-root}/_arcwright/core/tasks/workflow.xml • Adapt intent-driven planning to the task; complete applicable work with relevant evidence
